I almost always use between 50% and 100% of full context during my sessions and I always use lots of tools. So no, there are no issues. Try my command first.

additionaly my pi config (probably broken - never set any reasoning settings - but works):

{
  "providers": {
    "llamacpp": {
      "baseUrl": "http://<private-endpoint>/v1",
      "api": "openai-completions",
      "apiKey": "dummy",
      "compat": {
        "supportsDeveloperRole": false,
        "supportsReasoningEffort": false,
        "maxTokensField": "max_tokens"
      },
      "models": [
        {
          "id": "local",
          "input": ["text", "image"],
          "name": "llama.cpp",
          "contextWindow": 262144,
          "maxTokens": 100000
        }
      ]
    },
    "llamacpp_windows_local": {
      "baseUrl": "http://<private-endpoint>/v1",
      "api": "openai-completions",
      "apiKey": "dummy",
      "compat": {
        "supportsDeveloperRole": false,
        "supportsReasoningEffort": false,
        "maxTokensField": "max_tokens"
      },
      "models": [
        {
          "id": "local-win",
          "name": "llama.cpp local windows",
          "contextWindow": 50000,
          "maxTokens": 10000
        }
      ]
    }
  }
}

When using qwen in Pi, dont forget about the thinking format field. When using Shift+Tab, you can toggle thinking on/off, and Pi will make sure llama.cpp respects it. Nice for moments when you want quick, direct answers.

          "id": "qwen3.6-27b",
          "reasoning": true,
          "contextWindow": 160000,
          "maxTokens": 16000,
          "compat": {
            "thinkingFormat": "qwen-chat-template"
          }

(to be precise, it handles the chat_template_kwargs: { enable_thinking: true, preserve_thinking: true } flow)

I just gotta say that I setup MTP last night and it literally doubled my t/s. Game changer.

TyedalWaves
•
2mo ago

Alright! Thank you sir. Quick Question: What is a good speed in regards to tok/s for a local LLM Coding model with a setup that I have? (I'm new and I love learning!)

sine120
•
2mo ago
 Top 1% Commenter

Whatever you find acceptable. You don't really get to negotiate. I don't have any 3090's, but I'd expect you'd be getting 30-60 tkps with decent PP speeds, which will feel like a normal cloud provider.

TyedalWaves
•
2mo ago

Ah, okay! Tysm, I was just wondering because when I ran Qwen3.6 35b it hit around 110tok/s but it was super quantized and had no idea what to expect at a higher quant. Again, tysm!

TheTerrasque
•
2mo ago

That's the sparse model. The 27b is dense and smarter, but slower. 30-60 is expected speed for the dense, with mtp enabled
